Name: Abiseniya Lemma
Bio: Hi there, thank you for being here! I'm Abiseniya Lemma, a young professional with four years of experience in non-profit management including leading large-scale projects, team management, and driving innovation. I am consistently striving for equity and inclusion across the world through cross-cultural connections and understanding. I'm passionate about AIESEC United States and the opportunity I have to develop and empower over 250 student leaders across the nation as Head of Volunteers. If you are interested in what we do in AIESEC or my impact on our world, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Name: Elizabeth Onibokun
Bio: I'm a rising fourth-year political science student at UCLA with a concentration in international relations and a minor in history. I love all things AIESEC and have always been concerned with global issues and foreign policy. With a Jamaican mother and Nigerian father, culture is extremely important in my family and is the main component of my life. I grew up dancing ballet and modern and love to travel whenever I can!

Name: Ian Kawetschanky
Bio: Faced with a once in a lifetime opportunity - I made the unconventional but correct choice to defer my final semester studying Marketing and Entrepreneurship at UW-Madison's Wisconsin School of Business to assume the role of Vice President of Business Development for the AIESEC United States. I then served as the President of AIESEC United States through July 2020, which tested my leadership and resolve in ways I never imagined.

Name: Magdalene Ho
Bio: I'm a college student from Boston, MA studying marketing at Baylor University in Waco, TX.

Name: Marina Manova
Bio: As a passionate youth leader, she is dedicated to empowering young individuals to reach their full potential and create positive change. With a strong belief in the power of youth, she has led diverse teams and facilitated impactful programs that foster personal growth, leadership development, and community engagement. Through her work, she strives to inspire and equip young leaders with the skills, knowledge, and resources they need to make a difference in the world.

Name: Marjon Saulon
Bio: Born and raised in Asia, Marjon is a current writer and non-profit communications professional in California. He manages his blog, Third-Culture Thoughts, and writes about everything related to culture, the international experience, and success. He served as Local Committee President of AIESEC San Diego in 2017. Personal website: www.marjonsaulon.com Blog: www.third-culturethoughts.com

Name: Mateusz Milaszewski
Bio: A Junior at the University of Colorado Boulder pursuing a degree in marketing with an emphasis in global business and a minor in Spanish. Striving to promote sustainability and cross-cultural competence. Culturally integrated, trilingual, determined, constantly striving for personal and professional development, and passionate about travel with a love for nature.

Name: Nathaniel Kroah
Bio: AIESEC United States | Vice President of Finance | A Midwesterner living in New York City

Name: Nishad Kinhikar
Bio: I am a 23-year-old MBA Graduate from India and an introverted travel enthusiast. Despite my shyness, I've discovered the beauty of connecting with others, and it has truly enriched my life. I love exploring new places, and my blog VeryFirstTale aims to share my personal adventures, stories and experiences. I hope to inspire my readers to step out of their comfort zones and create their own unforgettable tales. Join me on this journey as we explore the world together!

Name: Soraya Morales
Bio: 👋🏻 Hey there! I'm Soraya (she/her/hers), a 27-year-old woman from Mexico working remotely around Latin America. I have over 5 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Project Management, and Marketing. By working in challenging environments in more than 6 countries, I developed skills, such as strategic thinking, assertive communication, creative problem-solving, teamwork, and active listening. Throughout my professional journey, have led and worked in cross-cultural and cross-functional teams, which made me feel passionate about diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Additionally, by working with global NGOs and MNCs in CSR projects, I feel the responsibility to contribute to a more sustainable world.

Name: Vinícius Valentim
Bio: Vinícius is a Law student at the Federal University of Ceará. He is Polyglot and foreign affairs geek, and he tries his best every day to fight against any mindset that goes against diversity.

Name: Wendy Chen
Bio: UCLA | University of California Los Angeles

Name: Yokelvy Vargas Prud-Home
Bio: Yokelvy Vargas Prud-Home is the Head of External Relations & Incoming Global Talent at AIESEC in the United States. Passionate about youth leadership and international collaboration, he works to build strategic partnerships that create meaningful cross-cultural experiences and advance the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and Youth Development
